# Vendored browser dependency

`markdown-it.min.js`: markdown-it **15.0.3**, the package's `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js` from npm, with its MIT license preserved in `markdown-it.LICENSE.txt`.

Served locally so opening the app does not load a third-party JavaScript CDN. Raw HTML and image loading are disabled by the application's renderer. Only HTTP(S) links are accepted.
